welcome_text: Welcome to Our School Welcome to our Tutor Time daycare and preschool in Anaheim Hills, CA! We offer an individualized curriculum based on the needs of each little one in our care. The curriculum is based on milestones and observations for each child. We're committed to keeping you connected throughout the day while your child is in our care. Get access to live streaming video of your child's classroom, plus other real-time updates, with our exclusive mobile app for families, SproutAbout. Since our school opened in 1998, we have provided a warm and welcoming learning environment for children. We encourage you to schedule a tour with us and become part of our loving family!

Since our school opened in 1998, we have provided a warm and welcoming learning environment for children. We encourage you to schedule a tour with us and become part of our loving family! Daycare and Early Education Programs Infants 6 weeks – 1 year old Get a one-of-a-kind start for your child, with nurturing care and milestone development. Toddlers 1 – 2 years old Movement, exploration, and discovery! Experience active learning opportunities. Twos 2 – 2.5 years old Let's get moving! These little learners are on the go, and their energy powers learning. Early Preschool 2.5 – 3 years old Prepare for Preschool, while developing confidence and gaining independence as a learner. Preschool 3 – 4 years old Hands-on learning experience guide children toward kindergarten and elementary school readiness. Transitional Kindergarten Plus 4– 5 years old This comprehensive, full-day program, with experienced teachers, prepares 4- and 5-year-olds for kindergarten. Before & After School Start and end the day strong with planned activities, healthy snacks, and homework help. Summer Camp Our full-day program is full of exploration, discovery, and wonder through unique weekly themes. Here's what people have to say Open a window to your child's day. SproutAbout ® , our exclusive family app, provides free live streaming video of your child's classroom to your mobile device. Choose Transitional Kindergarten Plus Our comprehensive, full-day Transitional Kindergarten Plus program is designed with engaging experiences and personalized learning for 4- and 5-year-olds, to set them up for kindergarten success. We're ALL IN on preparing your child for kindergarten! Our heroes matter to us. We welcome families that participate in assistance programs including Child Care Aware of America and USDA Child Care Subsidy and we offer a tuition discount too! Learn About Electives Handwriting & Advanced Math, Music, Phonics, Soccer, Spanish, Yoga Meet Our Staff Kelsie Nanez, Director Education : Bachelor's Degree in Sociology Certifications : CPR/First Aid I have worked with Learning Care Group since 2015. Within the company, I have joined different centers and have gained experience that I am now able to implement on my own as a director at Anaheim Hills. Becoming the center director of Tutor Time Anaheim Hills has filled me with happiness and has given me the pleasure of watching the center grow. I am looking forward to making this center my home!
